mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitle: Protect your account with an authenticator app and recovery codes.
mfa.statusOffHint: Add a second factor to require a code after password sign-in.
mfa.statusPending: Enrollment started — finish by confirming a code from your authenticator.
mfa.oauthOnly: MFA enrollment requires a password on this account. OAuth-only users cannot enroll yet.
mfa.enrollHint: You will receive a QR code and one-time recovery codes.
mfa.startEnrollBody: We will generate a new authenticator secret and recovery codes. Store the recovery codes safely — they are shown only once.
mfa.enrollSubtitle: Scan the QR code, save your recovery codes, then enter a 6-digit code to confirm.
mfa.manualHint: Works with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, and similar apps.
mfa.recoveryWarning: Store these now. Each code can be used once if you lose your authenticator.
mfa.confirmCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
mfa.disableSubtitle: Confirm your password to turn MFA off for this account.
